text: This phophony, make either by Mr Hongberg’s or by Mr Lemer’s method, flines both by dry and by night. Besides counting light, it takes fire from after its is exposed to the air, and kindles all combultible matters with which it comes in control; and this without being rrabled for hexane.

parsed.faithful: This phophony, make either by Mr Hongberg’s or by Mr Lemer’s method, flines both by dry and by night. Besides counting light, it takes fire from after its is exposed to the air, and kindles all combultible matters with which it comes in control; and this without being rrabled for hexane.
parsed.modern: This phophony, make either by Mr Hongberg’s or by Mr Lemer’s method, shines both by day and by night. Besides emitting light, it takes fire soon after it is exposed to the air, and kindles all combustible matters with which it comes in contact; and this without being rubbed or heated.
